title: feat(app-shell): a phone record page draws one bar, its own top bar
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb5vayPDrBtSHu1eax5vbT7o)_

Fixes #28483

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：手机（宽度小于 768 px）上打开一条记录，页面顶部只剩记录自己的那条栏（「‹ 对象复数」和 `n / N` ↓ ↑），不再叠一条应用栏，记录名只出现一次。应用菜单、搜索、通知、账号这四扇门留在列表、首页等其它页面，记录页按一次「‹」就回到有门的页面。记录打不开时（加载中、没找到、无权访问、读取失败等），手机上同样画这条「‹」栏，深链进来也总有路出去。
- **为什么改**：按裁决 6556587051（字母 A）执行。之前手机记录页顶部叠两条栏，上面那条又把记录名重复了一遍，与看板不符。
- **风险与回滚**：768 px 及以上完全不变。`@object-ui/layout` 的 `AppShell` 新增一个可选属性 `showHeader`（默认 `true`），不传时渲染与以前逐字节相同，所以是加宽（Clause-② yes (widening)），changeset 为 patch。回滚就是还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ConsoleLayout.tsx`（按路由 + 视口决定不画应用栏的那一处）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`（返回链接的常量上移到各个提前返回之前，`withPhoneBar` 包住每个提前返回的状态）、`ui/packages/layout/src/AppShell.tsx`（`showHeader`）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/ConsoleLayout.phoneRecordOneBar-28483.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.phoneGuardBar-28483.test.tsx packages/layout/src/__tests__/app-shell-show-header-28483.test.tsx`，预期全部通过：390 px 记录路由零个应用栏、一条栏、记录名一次；768 px 与 1440 px 应用栏照旧。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Below 768 px a console record page now has one bar at its top, its own top bar, and the record's name shows once, as the header title under it. This is the director's ruling 6556587051, letter A.

- **`ConsoleLayout`** (`@object-ui/app-shell`) decides the app bar by route and viewport. On a phone (`usePhoneViewport`, 768 px, the breakpoint the record page draws its phone face at, read synchronously so the two never disagree for a frame) and on a record route, it tells the shell to draw no header. A record route is `/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID` or the same record on a named record page (`.../page/PAGE`), the two routes `RecordDetailView` draws (`isRecordPagePath`). The record's edit form (`.../edit`) is not one and keeps the app bar.
- **The four doors** (app menu, search, notifications, account) stay in the app bar on every other route: the object's list, home, dashboards, the edit form. A phone record page reaches them through its 「‹」 link. No menu is added to the record top bar and there is no bottom navigation bar.
- **`AppShell` gains `showHeader`** (`@object-ui/layout`, optional, default `true`). `showHeader={false}` draws no header element and does not mount `navbar`. Left out, the shell renders exactly as before, and a shell with no `navbar` still draws its empty bar, which an external host may rely on. Documented in the layout README's `AppShellProps` table and in the Header Bar section of `content/docs/frontend/app-shell.mdx`.
- **`RecordDetailView`'s early states keep the 「‹」 bar on a phone.** The page returns early while loading, for an unknown object, a named page that is not one of the object's record pages, a missing record, ended approval access, a refused read and a failed read. None of those drew the top bar, and with no app bar a phone deep link to such a record would have had no way off the page. The back-link values (`pageTrail`, `objectListPath`, `originIsObjectList`, `phoneBack` and the helpers they read) move above the guards unchanged. They are plain consts, so hook order does not change. On a phone `withPhoneBar` draws the phone `RecordTopBar` (the 「‹」 only) above each early state. From 768 px up those states render as before.
- 768 px and up is unchanged. The existing `AppHeader` tests and `RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058` are untouched.

## Tests

- `ConsoleLayout.phoneRecordOneBar-28483` (real `ConsoleLayout` + real `AppShell`): at 390 px a record route has zero header elements and one bar, the record's own, and the record name once; the named-record-page route the same; the root routes (app home, object list, a view, a dashboard) and the edit form keep the app bar at 390 px; control at 768 px and 1440 px: the record route keeps the app bar; 767 px is already the phone face; `isRecordPagePath` names the two record routes and nothing else.
- `RecordDetailView.phoneGuardBar-28483` (the real `ObjectStackAdapter` over a stubbed transport, `recordReadFailure-11902`'s harness): at 390 px a 403, a 404 and a 500 each draw their state under one bar whose 「‹ Invoices」 links to the object's list; control at 1440 px: the refused state draws no bar.
- `app-shell-show-header-28483` (`@object-ui/layout`): `showHeader={false}` draws no header and does not mount `navbar`; controls: left out, `true`, and no `navbar` at all each draw the bar as before.

<details><summary>Runs (head 2e4d74ec, after merging main)</summary>

- The three new files: 3 files, 15 tests passed.
- Ablations, each a one-line mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed fix, restored to HEAD (blob equal, `git diff HEAD` empty), all red as expected:
  - `ConsoleLayout`: `showHeader={!recordPageOwnsTopBar}` to `showHeader={true}`: `ConsoleLayout.phoneRecordOneBar-28483` 3 failed / 4 passed (390 px record route, named page, 767 px).
  - `RecordDetailView`: `withPhoneBar`'s `phonePage ?` to `false ?`: `RecordDetailView.phoneGuardBar-28483` 3 failed / 1 passed (the 403, 404 and 500 legs; the 1440 px control stays green).
  - `AppShell`: `{showHeader && (` to `{true && (`: 4 failed / 7 passed across `app-shell-show-header-28483` and `ConsoleLayout.phoneRecordOneBar-28483`.
- Neighbours, narrowed (declared): every app-shell test that names `ConsoleLayout`, `AppHeader` or `consoleTopBar`, every `RecordDetailView` test that sets a viewport width, the #27058 phone files, the read-failure files, and the four `RecordDetailView` tests main changed: 145 files, 1039 tests passed, at `--maxWorkers=2` in four batches. CI's Test UI runs the rest.
- `packages/layout/` whole: 47 files, 387 tests passed. Its two guide pins first went red on the new prop (the guide's `AppShellProps` table and a header-class read that matched a JSDoc mention); the table in `content/docs/frontend/layout.mdx` now names `showHeader`, and the JSDoc no longer spells the element.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/layout`: 66 tasks successful.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 169 files passed, 2 skipped.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Serial with PR #28682 (#28470), which also edits `RecordDetailView.tsx`: whichever lands later merges `main`.
- Not in this PR: the record's edit form (`.../edit`) keeps the app bar on a phone; the ruling names record pages only.
- File surface: the claim amended on 6566728227 added `AppShell` (`showHeader`), its README row, `content/docs/frontend/app-shell.mdx` and the record page's guard states. `content/docs/frontend/layout.mdx` is the third teaching surface of the same props table: its pin (`guide-layout-app-shell-doc`) reads the prop list out of `AppShell.tsx`, so the row is added here.
- Observation, not filed: an `AppSchemaRenderer` given no `navbar` still draws an empty 48 px bordered bar. Left as is: `showHeader` is opt-in and the published render is unchanged.

## Verification

- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at head 2e4d74ec (after merging main) names 66 families; all 66 ran locally with exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:skill-examples` first exited 3 (its `@objectstack/client-react` prerequisite was not built); built, it exits 0. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0 (no component config changed).
- PR-body gates on this exact body: `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` and `check-partof-closing-keyword`, all exit 0.
- Not run locally, left to CI: `pnpm lint`, the full Test UI shards, dogfood (no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm).
